description: Retrieve existing records and domains from DNSimple API.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The domain name to retrieve info from. Returns all associated records for this domain if specified. If not specified, returns all domains associated with the account ID.

parameters.name: record
parameters.description: The record to find. If specified, only this record is returned instead of all records.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Whether or not to use sandbox environment. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Get all domains from an account
  community.general.dnsimple_info:
    account_id: "1234"
    api_key: "1234"

- name: Get all records from a domain
  community.general.dnsimple_info:
    name: "example.com"
    account_id: "1234"
    api_key: "1234"

- name: Get all info from a matching record
  community.general.dnsimple_info:
    name: "example.com"
    record: "subdomain"
    account_id: "1234"
    api_key: "1234"

return_values.name: dnsimple_domain_info
return_values.description: Returns a list of dictionaries of all domains associated with the supplied account ID. Returned: success when name is not specified Sample: [{"account_id": 1234, "created_at": "2021-10-16T21:25:42Z", "id": 123456, "last_transferred_at": null, "name": "example.com", "reverse": false, "secondary": false, "updated_at": "2021-11-10T20:22:50Z"}]

return_values.name: created_at
return_values.description: When the domain entry was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the entry. Returned: success

return_values.name: last_transferred_at
return_values.description: Date the domain was transferred, or empty if not. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the record. Returned: success

return_values.name: reverse
return_values.description: Whether or not it is a reverse zone record. Returned: success

return_values.name: updated_at
return_values.description: When the domain entry was updated. Returned: success

return_values.name: dnsimple_record_info
return_values.description: Returns a list of dictionaries that match the record supplied. Returned: success when name and record are specified Sample: [{"content": "1.2.3.4", "created_at": "2021-11-15T23:55:51Z", "id": 123456, "name": "catheadbiscuit", "parent_id": null, "priority": null, "regions": ["global"], "system_record": false, "ttl": 3600, "type": "A", "updated_at": "2021-11-15T23:55:51Z", "zone_id": "example.com"}]

return_values.name: content
return_values.description: Content of the returned record. Returned: success

return_values.name: parent_id
return_values.description: Parent record or null. Returned: success

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: Priority setting of the record. Returned: success

return_values.name: regions
return_values.description: List of regions where the record is available. Returned: success

return_values.name: system_record
return_values.description: Whether or not it is a system record. Returned: success

return_values.name: zone_id
return_values.description: ID of the zone that the record is associated with. Returned: success

return_values.name: dnsimple_records_info
return_values.description: Returns a list of dictionaries with all records for the domain supplied. Returned: success when name is specified, but record is not Sample: [{"content": "ns1.dnsimple.com admin.dnsimple.com", "created_at": "2021-10-16T19:07:34Z", "id": 12345, "name": "catheadbiscuit", "parent_id": null, "priority": null, "regions": ["global"], "system_record": true, "ttl": 3600, "type": "SOA", "updated_at": "2021-11-15T23:55:51Z", "zone_id": "example.com"}]
